title: Modularize SIG/CAIQ evidence and build self-serve attestation composer with pricing hooks
creator: Aisha Moreno
description:
Summary: Create a modular evidence model for SIG/CAIQ and other common security questionnaires and deliver a self-serve Attestation Composer in the Console. The composer enables sales/CS/legal to assemble curated evidence packs, attach customer-specific notes, and export a signed attestation bundle. Tie the composer to an experimentation matrix that evaluates two pricing/packaging approaches: (A) evidence credits consumed per attestation export, and (B) tiered attestation bundles included with higher Reserved/Dedicated plans.

Goals: 1) Reduce average time to respond to CAIQ/SIG by 60% for enterprise reps. 2) Enable self-serve attestation exports for 40% of mid-market contracts in Q2 pilot. 3) Gather pricing elasticity signals to recommend packaging that minimizes manual legal work while preserving revenue.

Success metrics: - Mean time from request to exported attestation (days) - % of attestation exports completed without Legal help - Revenue uplift or churn delta for customers who use bundled attestation options - Number of evidence templates reused across customers

Scope: - Canonical evidence schema (JSON + human-readable mapping) for CAIQ, SOC-like answers, and custom attestation fields. - Console UI: Attestation Composer (pick templates, select answers, attach supporting artifacts, save drafts, export signed PDF/zip). - Backend: evidence store, access controls, audit log entries, export generation service. - Billing hook: emit events to billing pipeline for credit-based experiments and flag customers in trial for bundled offers. - Integrations: link to Drive/Confluence evidence, link to contract systems (e.g., Salesforce CPQ) for automated attachment.

Out of scope for initial pilot: full legal workflow automation, auto-answering of questionnaires via LLMs (future work), deep SOC report generation.

Approach & milestones:
- Week 1 (2025-02-20 to 2025-02-26): Discovery interviews with sales/CS/legal; inventory common evidence artifacts; finalize canonical schema.
- Week 2: Implementation kickoff: evidence store APIs (ENG-4512), basic Composer UI wireframes (DES-204), audit logging spec.
- Week 3-4: Backend export worker and signed PDF pipeline; billing event prototype (ENG-4739).
- Week 5: Internal pilot with 3 enterprise reps; collect feedback and iterate on UX.
- Week 6-8: Pricing experiment rollout to subset of mid-market customers; A/B test credit-based vs bundled approaches.

Risks & mitigations: - Risk: Legal objects to self-serve exports. Mitigation: require legal approval gate for initial bundle templates; include prominent disclaimers and an approval-required flag per template. - Risk: Evidence duplicates and version drift. Mitigation: versioned artifacts, canonical answers with change history, automatic recommendation of latest artifacts. - Risk: Billing edge-cases cause disputes. Mitigation: emit rich event logs and provide consumption details in Billing Console; build a grace-period policy for disputed credits.

Stakeholders: Product (Aisha Moreno), Eng Leads (Liam Chen), Design (Maya Patel), Legal (Evan Rios), Sales Ops (Priya Gupta), Finance/Billing (Omar Diaz).

Data & measurement: Track UI events (compose:start, compose:export, compose:attach-evidence), attach to a dashboard with cohort breakdown (pilot vs control). Capture support tickets and time-to-resolution. Use experiment registry to capture revenue and churn signals.

Rollout plan: 6-week internal pilot -> 4-week controlled A/B with two cohorts (credit-based credits eligible vs bundled-attestation included) -> iterate -> general availability behind a Console feature flag with opt-in for enterprise accounts.

Notes & links: Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Attestation+Composer (draft); design frames: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/attestation-composer-wires; billing PR prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/178.

Next steps (immediate): 1) Align with Legal on mandatory review templates by 2025-02-24. 2) Create ENG ticket for export worker and sign-off schema (ENG-4512). 3) Kickoff design sprint for Composer (DES-204).
